message.content:
This is a women's sleeveless blouse of knit polyester/elastane fabric. Knit women's blouses fall under heading 6106 (women's blouses, shirts and shirt-blouses, knitted or crocheted). Under subheading 6106.90, man-made fibers go to 6106.90.25 (other, of man-made fibers), with 6106.90.2500 being the usual statistical suffix.

There is one wrinkle. The stitch count from the laboratory is odd: the text says 2 stitches per cm in one direction and 9 in the other, which probably should read 12 and 9 (the "35" looks like an OCR artifact). Either way, this appears to be a knit fabric, so heading 6106 applies. A tank-top alternative (6109) is possible for sleeveless garments, but the partial front opening with a zippered collar and the blouse description favor 6106.

The 6106.90.25 line is "Other: Of man-made fibers", and the full code is 6106.90.2530 (women's, other).
